main_body: Rectangular fenced crop field: wheat rows, cabbage-like rows and seedling rows inside a wooden post-and-rail fence
top_band: none for the field. A single column through the middle runs from golden wheat straight into green and brown crop rows, with no top band and no front face. Only the fence rails have a light tan band of about 3 rows (rows 2-4) over a darker face.
evidence: The main body is the crop plot, drawn as a flat plan seen from above, with rows of plants laid out on a ground plane. It has no front face, no height and no standing structure. The fence rails are thin side elevations and are a minor detail. The piece does not fit the open-frame kind either; it is a flat field tile, not a rack with beams and a base. It is a top-down plan with no front face, so it fails.

style.evidence: The crops carry several greens and golds with per-plant highlights, and the soil has grain. The wood fence is shaded in 3-4 browns with dark-brown outlines, not black. The wheat is speckled with highlights, and the grey ground is dithered, so there are no large flat fills. Tile density is comparable to the references.
